title: release_in_flight required once epics declare explicit releases; no invented v1
goal: Stop build-dashboard.mjs from inventing a false lowercase v1 release when release_in_flight is missing but epics declare explicit releases, and have validate.mjs catch the missing field as a hard error.
in_scope: validate.mjs: require release_in_flight (hard error) once any epic declares an explicit release; keep the existing mismatch check when release_in_flight is present

build-dashboard.mjs: when release_in_flight is absent but epics declare explicit releases, select a real declared release (prefer one that isn't fully done) and render a visible config-warning banner instead of falling back to 'v1'
Preserve implicit v1 exactly as today when no epic declares an explicit release and release_in_flight is absent
out_of_scope: Any change to how release_in_flight is advanced (still owned exclusively by define-backlog)
acceptance: An epic with an explicit release and no matching release_in_flight fails validate.mjs; build-dashboard.mjs selects an actual declared release and shows a visible configuration warning instead of a false 0/0 on-track dashboard.
invariants: This new validate.mjs check is a hard error, never softened by legacyContractGrace
A backlog.json with zero epics, or all-implicit-v1 epics, is unaffected
